dataset.name: Unsent, narrowly scoped record requests for WTC 1 stair-plan source records
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9Y. Using only hashed local snapshots of the current official NIST FOIA instructions and the PANYNJ records-request form, prepare two precise local drafts for records limited to WTC 1 sheets A-A-148, A-A-150, A-A-151 and A-A-153 and the minimum revision, register, custody and release context needed to identify them. Do not send, post or submit either request. Do not acquire any additional plan dataset, create coordinates, promote geometry, assign physical properties or damage credit, run a structural solver, launch Blender or modify the protected Blender master.

required_text: How do I make a FOIA request?
Do I need to complete a form?
estimated fee before the charge is incurred

request_scope.building: World Trade Center 1 / North Tower / Tower A
request_scope.explicit_exclusion: This is not a request for every World Trade Center drawing or for WTC 7 drawings.
request_scope.known_mismatch_to_disambiguate: NIST FOIA 12-178 / WTCI-120 is documented in V9Y as WTC 7 Architectural Drawings 1 through 65 and is not the target release.
request_scope.native_format_definition: The source CAD or original digital image file actually held by the receiving agency; the request does not require creation of a new record or conversion into a format the agency does not hold.
request_scope.highest_resolution_fallback: If no native source file is held, provide the highest-resolution scan or image version actually held, together with existing file metadata when available.

record_categories.description: Native CAD/DWG/DXF files or original digital image files actually held for each target sheet.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing native format with original filename and extension
record_categories.purpose: Determine whether source information exists beyond the cached 200 dpi 1-bit raster.

record_categories.description: Highest-resolution scan or raster actually held for each target sheet if no native file is held.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing lossless or source raster format
record_categories.purpose: Test whether printed digits and extension-line endpoints are recoverable without interpolation.

record_categories.description: Existing records preserving the complete sheet number, title, issue date and title block for each target sheet.
record_categories.purpose: Confirm exact sheet identity and scope.

record_categories.description: Revision blocks, revision descriptions, supersession records and issue histories for each target sheet.
record_categories.purpose: Distinguish versions and avoid treating an unidentified issue as authoritative.

record_categories.description: The smallest drawing register, index or file listing that identifies the four target sheets and their revisions.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing spreadsheet, database export, PDF or image
record_categories.purpose: Map the target sheet numbers to controlled records without requesting an entire drawing corpus.

record_categories.description: Transmittal, accession, receipt, inventory, box, reel, disk or media records specifically identifying any target sheet or target digital file.
record_categories.purpose: Establish file-level custody or receipt rather than relying on a public distribution label.

record_categories.description: Existing release, disclosure, FOIA, public-records or transfer records specifically identifying one or more target sheets.
record_categories.purpose: Identify the documented release path and distinguish it from unrelated WTC 7 releases.

record_categories.description: Existing file metadata for each held target file, including filename, size, pixel dimensions, resolution, bit depth, color mode, compression, checksum and creation/modification timestamps when recorded.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing metadata export, inventory or sidecar
record_categories.purpose: Compare source quality and identify exact duplicates without asking the agency to create forensic metadata.

record_categories.description: Any prior or superseding version of a target sheet that is separately held and identifiable by date or revision.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing native or highest-resolution electronic copy

record_categories.description: Any existing certification, stamp, transmittal or index entry specifically stating that a target version is field-verified, record-drawing or as-built; no such status is presumed.
record_categories.purpose: Test status with an explicit record rather than inferring it from image appearance.

record_categories.description: If a target record is not held, the existing record of transfer, destruction, retention disposition, referral, withholding or responsible custodian, to the extent recorded and releasable.
record_categories.preferred_format: Existing disposition record or written record-status response
record_categories.purpose: Document the remaining gap and direct any later request without assuming a missing record exists.

record_categories.description: The smallest existing legend or identifier key needed to interpret accession, database, media or drawing-register identifiers attached to the target records.
record_categories.preferred_format: Electronic copy of existing legend or key
record_categories.purpose: Make file-level identifiers intelligible while keeping the request narrow.

evidence_policy.observed_or_transcribed_fact: Route text, addresses, page count and fee/cadrage language directly inspected in the two hashed official agency snapshots.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: V9Z creates no official-model result; earlier NIST modelling remains context only.
evidence_policy.archive_claim: No new archive claim is accepted. V9Y public distribution labels remain unverified as agency receipt or as-built status.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: LOW, BASE and HIGH remain separate hypothetical display placements inherited without modification.
evidence_policy.derived_result: The two unsent drafts, record-category matrix, route audit and all documentary/model-gate decisions.
evidence_policy.contradiction_or_unknown: Whether either agency holds a native file, superior scan, revision register, file-level receipt or field/as-built certification remains unknown until a response is received and separately validated.

next_iteration.objective: Preserve V8U through V9Z and build a solver-neutral, source-gated readiness schema for the seven-floor 93-99 core, office-floor, perimeter and transfer paths. Enumerate required nodes, elements, connections, units, provenance and missing properties, but assign no capacity, solver geometry or damage state where data are absent. Retain official-model dependence labels and run neither Blender nor a structural solver.
